sentences.text:
For the Petitioner : Mr. S.P. Roy, Advocate For the State : Mrs. Amrita Kumari, A.P.P.
---
Order No. 02 Dated 7th August, 2023 Heard the learned counsel for the respective sides.
The petitioner is an accused in connection with Lalmatiya P.S. Case No. 69 of 2019 (G.R. No. 1167 of 2022).
The land of village Taljhari was acquired for ECL under the Coal Bearing Areas Acquisition and Development Act, 1957.

entities.text: Coal Bearing Areas Acquisition and Development Act, 1957
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The compensation of Rs. 1.5 crores were paid and some employments were also provided.
It has been alleged that whenever excavation work started, one Manbel Hansda and his associates stopped the work through force.
It appears that Manbel Hansda has been granted bail by this Court in BA No. 10053 of 2022.
So far as the petitioner is concerned, he has been implicated on the confession of co-accused Manbel Hansda.
The petitioner is in custody since 23.02.2023.

Regard being had to the above, the petitioner is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Godda in connection with Lalmatiya P.S. Case No. 69 of 2019 (G.R. No. 1167 of 2022).
MK (RONGON MUKHOPADHYAY,J.)
